description: Changes the business name shown to customers, as the Settings business-name field does; it flows into every quote, email, SMS and the payment descriptor. A name can be changed back. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying. An owner-level change: Sergio tells the owner after it is made.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

reason.description: Why you are doing this, in one sentence. The owner sees it in the notice Sergio sends after the change.

name: rename_organization
title: Rename the business
